integration_issues.flow: Web session token persistence for paywall server-sync
integration_issues.issue: authTokenForServer (line 3547) reads localStorage.getItem('gracefy_app_token'), but the app stores the login token under key 'user_token' (line 4318, 4350, 4882, 2617, etc). On page reload, user?.token is undefined (since /user/me response has no `token` field), so the Bearer header is never sent to /api/monetization/usage or /api/monetization/record-skip. Consequence: server-side skip counter never hydrates or increments across reloads for web users; the paywall is only enforced from the current tab's in-memory local counter. Server IS the source of truth per iter57 design, but that source is unreachable. This is a pre-existing regression (not introduced in iter59) but it blocks the 'uncircumventable paywall' promise on web.

integration_issues.flow: isPremium initialization causes bumpUsage bypass on cold load
integration_issues.issue: useState(true) default for isPremium (line 3470) combined with the wasPremiumRef effect (lines 3898-3924) causes 'User became premium — clearing enforcement' to fire on almost every mount (it wipes gracefy_monetization localStorage AND POSTs /api/monetization/reset — 403's for non-premium but still). Additionally, when axios GET /user/subscription-status intermittently fails (observed in preview environment — 'Failed to check subscription: AxiosError' logged), the catch handler sets setIsPremium(!billingEnabled) but by that time billingEnabled might still be its initial value, leaving isPremium=true (default). handleSkipWithBillingCheck then short-circuits with 'FREE PATH (billing off or premium)' at line 5265 → bumpUsage() never fires → paywall never triggers via the next button. Repro: fresh login on web, hit next 9 times → observed usage=2/9 (only counts firing when isPremium=false window aligns) or no counts at all. This is a pre-existing frontend issue that blocked automated UI verification of the iter59 fixes.

action_items: P0 (pre-existing, blocks iter59 UI verification): Fix isPremium default useState to false, or delay bumpUsage-eligible clicks until billingStatusChecked=true. Current default=true + intermittent axios failure = paywall bypassed silently.

P0 (pre-existing): Unify localStorage token key. `user_token` is written on login but `gracefy_app_token` is what /api/monetization/usage + /record-skip Bearer sync reads. Server counter never hydrates on web reload. Either set both keys on login, or change reads to use `user_token`, or persist the token onto the user object after /user/me.

P2 (pre-existing): wasPremiumRef reset effect (3898-3924) fires 'User became premium — clearing enforcement' on cold mount despite the null-guard, wiping gracefy_monetization localStorage AND POSTing /monetization/reset. Investigate double-fire in dev/StrictMode (or genuine false→true transition in production) — the reset POST returns 403 for non-premium so no server damage, but the localStorage wipe defeats the 'paywall survives reload' guarantee for web.

P2 (pre-existing): /api/user/subscription-status axios call intermittently fails on preview URL (AxiosError logged 2x in preview run; curl and fetch to same URL both return 200). Investigate axios timeout/interceptor config.
critical_code_review_comments: iter59 modal fix is well-guarded: player?.togglePlay type-checked, wrapped in try/catch, and only fires when currentSong loaded AND !isPlaying. Good defensive coding.

The SubscriptionPromptModal at line 7060 (separate from the daily-limit paywall) STILL calls setView('profile') on its onSubscribe. If any code path opens BOTH modals or the wrong one, the old bad UX would recur. Recommend also switching that one to setShowCheckoutModal(true) for consistency.

monetizationSettings default `hard_skip_limit: 6` (line 3518) diverges from server threshold=9. If /admin/settings/monetization fetch fails, client would show wrong '6' in various UI copies. Consider server-first-required semantics with a loading state.

The 'User became premium — clearing enforcement' effect wipes gracefy_monetization even when the transition is a spurious StrictMode/re-render artifact. This is the mechanism defeating my UI test setup. Recommend gating on billingStatusChecked=true AND a positive is_premium API response before clearing.

Trial account status: /api/user/register returns trial.status='active' but /api/user/subscription-status returns is_premium=false. That's semantically fine but worth documenting — 'trial' does NOT bypass the paywall on server, only true is_premium/subscription_status='active'|'trialing' does.
Post-modal hint copy is dynamic and correct, but the SwEng hint reads 'Kila ya 4' — sw grammar review: 'Kila wimbo wa 4' or 'Kila nyimbo ya 4' would be more natural. Minor i18n polish opportunity.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For future UI paywall triggering: (1) login via the actual UI form so React `user` state contains .token in-memory (not via localStorage seeding — that misses user.token), (2) either wait for billingStatusChecked=true state OR mock axios subscription-status to return is_premium=false quickly, (3) use an album with >1 songs so next actually advances rather than looping, (4) seed skip_count=threshold-1=8 in user_billing_stats AND ensure client localStorage 'gracefy_monetization' is NOT wiped by the wasPremiumRef effect. The three iter59 code fixes are correct by inspection; no code changes required. Main agent should manual-smoke via a real browser session.
rca of the issue: Iter59 targeted fix code (modal button handlers) is CORRECT by inspection. My inability to trigger the paywall via automation surfaces two orthogonal pre-existing bugs: (1) token key mismatch (`user_token` written, `gracefy_app_token` read) breaks server-side skip sync on reload — makes iter57's 'uncircumventable' server counter unreachable from web after refresh; (2) isPremium=true default combined with wasPremiumRef reset effect and axios failure paths creates a window where handleSkipWithBillingCheck short-circuits to the FREE path so bumpUsage never fires. Both bugs INDEPENDENTLY exist in the codebase before iter59 changes. iter59's edits (lines 7091-7113, 7122-7123) do NOT touch either bug. Recommend main agent: (a) quick manual smoke of the modal (login → play 9x next → click each button → verify), OR (b) fix action items 1+2 first, then automated E2E becomes feasible.
